checkpoint_timing.name: checkpoint_timing
checkpoint_timing.value: ("checkpoints"."anchor" = 'free' and "checkpoints"."date" is not null) or ("checkpoints"."anchor" = 'project_end' and "checkpoints"."date" is null)

workspace_limits_positive.name: workspace_limits_positive
workspace_limits_positive.value: "workspaces"."revision" >= 0 and "workspaces"."people_revision" >= 0 and "workspaces"."max_projects" > 0 and "workspaces"."max_processes" > 0 and "workspaces"."max_tasks" > 0 and "workspaces"."max_people" > 0 and "workspaces"."max_editors" > 0 and "workspaces"."max_guests" > 0
